title: ZipMould Challenge v1: code and evidence for a controlled edge-feedback study
description: Synthetic Challenge v1 benchmark and reproducibility package for Does Edge Feedback Help? Includes the pre-test protocol and code snapshot, 150 released test puzzles with Hamiltonian certificates, 9000 trial rows, 4020 returned solutions, 10000 bootstrap replicates, and the manuscript source. The primary full-minus-frozen solve-probability difference is +1.29 percentage points, with a 95% stratified puzzle-bootstrap interval of [-0.04, +2.64] points. The predeclared classification is practically equivalent under a +/-5-point band. Third-party legacy puzzle data are excluded.
